purpose: Conceptual README illustrations, not application screenshots or transaction evidence

assets.prompt: Create a polished AI-generated editorial illustration for the Obolos GitHub README. Horizontal canvas about 1792x1024, composition designed to remain very legible at 850 pixels wide. Warm cream background #FAF8F3, crisp near-black outlines #191919, flat muted lilac #B8A4C4 and coral-orange #FF6048 fills. Flat 2D drawing, expressive geometric robot characters with tiny eyes and simple arms, thoughtful modern editorial print aesthetic. No shadows, no gradients, no 3D, no noise, no faux screenshot, no watermark. Scene: an open digital marketplace with five distinct simple kiosk/counter forms arranged in a shallow semicircle, generous negative space. Each kiosk is staffed by a different geometric agent (circle, rounded square, triangle, flower-like gear, capsule); foreground a buyer agent carrying a small task card is considering the sellers. On the kiosks display exactly these short labels, one label each, large clean consistent black sans-serif uppercase: DATA, COMPUTE, INFERENCE, VERIFY, STORAGE. Use corresponding clear 2D line icons: document, processor, speech bubble, check-in-circle, archive box. Small coral tokens and outlined document cards connect the buyer and two stalls with a few tidy curved directional arrows. Friendly but sophisticated, not children clipart. Balanced composition, understated line details, roomy margins. No headline, no extra text, no numbers, no adoption metrics, no logos. This is a conceptual product illustration, not evidence of actual independent users.

Generate a beautiful informative flat 2D editorial flow illustration for the Obolos GitHub README, horizontal wide 1792x1024 canvas. Warm cream #FAF8F3, near-black #191919 crisp outlines, muted lilac #B8A4C4 and coral orange #FF6048 flat fills. No shadows, gradients, 3D, texture noise, watermark or simulated app interface. Four large evenly-spaced stations connected LEFT TO RIGHT by clean black arrows, with generous whitespace. Station 1: stylized human hand signs a simple task-plan card, icon of pen and bounded checklist. Label exactly APPROVE. Station 2: a geometric agent hands a coral token into a simple settlement machine. Label exactly PAY. Below this station a compact branching allocation illustration with THREE clearly separated outputs and EXACT large labels: 95% SELLER, 3% RESERVE, 2% REVIEW POOL. These allocations must add to 100 and never repeat percentages. Station 3: a friendly seller robot hands over an outlined actual output document with small code brackets and text strokes, no invented code or paragraphs. Label exactly DELIVER. Station 4: buyer robot receives the document and places a checkmark on a separate receipt. Label exactly ACKNOWLEDGE. Four station labels in large clean matching uppercase sans-serif text. The payer, seller and buyer are distinct geometric characters with small eyes, no real people or brand logos. Payment, delivery and acknowledgment clearly visually separate. This is a conceptual diagram of Arc service-purchase flow, not actual transaction proof. Keep all labels legible at 850 pixels image width. No other text.

Create a refined conceptual 2D editorial drawing for the Obolos GitHub README, wide horizontal 1792x1024 canvas, generous whitespace. Exact visual palette warm cream #FAF8F3 background, near-black #191919 ink outlines, coral orange #FF6048 and muted lilac #B8A4C4 flat fills. No shadows, no gradients, no 3D, no paper grain, no logos, no fake app screenshots. Composition: at top center a simplified human hand places a small signed policy card onto a wide horizontal boundary gate. The gate has three clean icon plaques labelled exactly BUDGET, SCOPE, EXPIRY in large black uppercase sans-serif. Budget icon coin plus boundary brackets; scope icon three selected small squares; expiry icon plain clock with no numbers. Below the gate, three friendly geometric agents stand in a neatly outlined open work area, one carries a task document, one holds a service card, one exchanges a coral payment token with an API counter. Show a small proposed action arrow traveling upward from an agent toward the human policy card, and an approved route passing through the gate into the working area. Make the relationship visually clear: humans establish authority, agents work within its limits. Beside the gate, a simple closed vault symbol holds a small key, distinctly outside the agents' work area to suggest private credentials stay with the trusted broker. Do not draw a physical Ledger device or imply keys are held by the agents. No invented connectivity labels. Only headline text at top left: HUMAN AUTHORITY, and the three plaque words BUDGET, SCOPE, EXPIRY. Minimal expressive ink linework and appealing character silhouettes, mature product illustration, crisp at 850 pixels wide.
